column1: # The anonymous field map, as data. FORMAT.md, Anonymous captures, says what each kind does; src/pseudonym.cpp holds the same rows.
# channel: 0 game, 1 search. opcode: the game header id, or byte 0x0B of a search packet. offset: bytes from the packet start (the game header, the search size).
# size: bytes per field; end runs to the packet end. count fields, stride bytes apart; a field past the packet end is skipped.

# kind: id (u32, a player id gets its pseudonym), name (NUL-padded letters get their pseudonym, the rest of the field zeroed), signature (item extra data: a crafter name at bytes 12-23 in 6-bit codes), text (zeroed by the anonymous policy), stream (a walker, FORMAT.md).
# when: the row applies only when the u16 at that offset, masked, equals the value. checked: captures (seen on retail packets of public Mogsafe captures) or layout (XiPackets, LandSandBoat).
